_note: AquaSolus book: 'This hot tub is perfect for you if...' for each model. AquaZen's own words, written from the specs and each series' positioning.
brook: You're new to hot tubs and want the easiest possible start.
It's mostly the two of you, or a small family.
Your patio or yard is on the smaller side.
You'd like to plug into a standard outlet, with no big electrical job.
zephyr: You and your partner both want to lie back and stretch out.
You still want room for the kids, or a couple of friends on a Friday night.
You want a simple, plug-and-play start to Zen Time.
cypress: Somebody in your house always claims the lounger, and everyone else still needs a seat.
You're a family of up to six getting your first hot tub.
You want room to stretch out without a big electrical job.
cove: You're a bigger family, or the house everyone ends up at.
You like upright seats, so everyone faces each other and actually talks.
You want the most room in Series One, on a standard outlet.
sierra: You're empty nesters, ready for Zen together.
You want to lie back side by side at the end of every day.
You don't need room for a crowd, just the two of you and the occasional guest.
You'll use it every night, all year, and want full power for the heater and jets together.
harmony: You and your partner both want a lounger, every night.
The kids or grandkids still pile in on weekends.
You want 42 jets and two pumps running at full power, year round.
eden: You're a family of four to six who'll use it most nights.
One lounger is plenty, and everyone takes their turn.
You want full power and a deep massage, without going bigger than you need.
aspen: You finish most days with tight shoulders and a sore back.
You want the deepest massage in Series Two, with 48 jets.
There's room for six, and a lounger for whoever needs it most.
calma: You have a big family, or you love to entertain.
You'd rather have seven upright seats than a lounger, so everyone fits and faces each other.
You want full power for every seat, every night.
cascade: You've owned a hot tub before and you know you love it.
You and your partner both want a full-length lounger.
You want a programmable massage that runs the sequence you choose, from slow and soft to deep.
You want water care that watches the water for you.
serenity: You've had a spa before, and this time you want the best water care there is.
You want a full-length lounger waiting for you at the end of the day.
There are up to six of you, and you'll use it every night.
zenith: You've owned hot tubs before and you're ready for the biggest one.
Your family is big, or your backyard is where everyone gathers.
You want the most room and the most jets: seven people and 61 jets.
solstice: You know you love hot tubs, and you want the best one to share.
You gather: seven upright seats, everyone face to face.
You want the best water care and a programmable massage, with room for the whole family.
